notes: Agency directory seeded from confirmed correspondence (Blackmatter Insight FOIA Machine, July 2026). Every entry below has a real email/portal address observed in actual agency correspondence. mailing_address is left null unless it was explicitly confirmed in correspondence -- verify with the agency's official site before mailing anything. Do not bulk-add unverified addresses; wrong contact info misdirects real legal filings.

agencies.name: Illinois State Police
agencies.notes: Reference format: FOIA #########. Has granted extensions same-day as due date historically -- confirm production date after extension notice.

agencies.name: Chicago Police Department
agencies.notes: Reference format: P######-MMDDYY. Escalation: Illinois PAC (Public Access Counselor).

agencies.name: Detroit Police Department / City of Detroit Law Dept FOIA Section
agencies.notes: Requires requester's mailing address stated explicitly in the request; agency has bounced requests back for 'no address' before responding on merits.

agencies.name: Sterling Heights Police Department
agencies.notes: Reference format: ##-####. Portal closes requests for 'NO ADDRESS' -- always include full mailing address in first submission.

agencies.name: Drug Enforcement Administration, FOIA/PA Unit
agencies.notes: Reference format: ##-#####-F. Supplemental identifying info accepted post-submission under 28 CFR 16.3(b).

agencies.name: Federal Bureau of Investigation, FOIPA
agencies.notes: fbi.foia@fbi.gov is NOT a valid new-request intake -- confirmed by bounce-back auto-reply. Must resubmit via eFOIPA portal; reference original submission date/field office.

agencies.name: Fairbanks Police Department
agencies.notes: Direct emails to fpd@fairbanks.us get redirected to the NextRequest portal -- submit there directly to avoid the round trip.

agencies.name: Delaware Department of Justice FOIA Coordinator
Kentucky State Police (appeals to AG Open Records Division)
agencies.notes: Reference format: ##-####. Appeals of denial go to KY AG Open Records Division under KRS 61.880(2), not back to KSP. Residency requirement: news-gathering orgs qualify as 'resident' under KRS 61.870(10)(f).

agencies.name: O'Fallon Police Department
agencies.notes: Reference format: MO-####-YYYYMMDD. Fee appeal precedent: Shields, 771 S.W.2d 107 (search/review not chargeable). Escalation: mandamus under RSMo 610.027 if waiver refused.

agencies.name: Polk County, Iowa (records custodian)
agencies.notes: Reference format: S######-MMYYYY. Fee estimate appeal precedent: Iowa PIB Advisory Opinion 19-02 (redaction cost is agency's, not requester's).

agencies.name: McKinney Police Department
agencies.notes: Reference format: P######-MMDDYY. Improper-closure escalation: Texas AG Open Records complaint under Tex. Gov't Code 552.301 within 10 business days of the missed deadline.

agencies.name: Provo Police Department
agencies.notes: Fee waiver precedent: Media One v. State (news media / public-interest basis). 10-business-day statutory response/waiver deadline.

agencies.name: Service de police de la Ville de Quebec (SPVQ)
agencies.statute: NOT FOIA -- Quebec Access to Information Act
agencies.statute_citation: An Act respecting Access to documents held by public bodies, CQLR c A-2.1
agencies.notes: IMPORTANT: do not cite 5 U.S.C. 552 in correspondence with this agency -- use Quebec's access-to-information law only. Reference format: VQ-##-####.

agencies.name: Ministerio de Seguridad Publica, Costa Rica (Contraloria de Servicios)
agencies.statute: NOT FOIA -- Costa Rica Ley de Acceso
agencies.notes: IMPORTANT: do not cite U.S. FOIA -- this correction was already sent once (see thread CR-3244-20260719). Use Ley 8220 exclusively for all Costa Rica correspondence.

agencies.name: Jordan National Library / gov.jo records office
agencies.statute: NOT FOIA -- verify Jordan's own access-to-information law before further correspondence
agencies.statute_citation: Jordan Right to Access Information Law No. 47 of 2007 (verify before citing)
agencies.notes: Reference format: JO-####-YYYYMMDD. Flagged: prior correspondence with this address incorrectly cited U.S. FOIA -- same mistake as Costa Rica and Quebec threads. Confirm this is even the correct office for police records before sending anything further.
